subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow 24-hour Cron Jobs timeline as the first Control UI slice, or require a broader calendar design before implementation continues?
rationale: The request adds new Control UI product surface, and the linked open PR only partially covers the requested daily/week calendar, stats, drag/drop editing, and validation behavior while also needing a substantial rebase.

options.title: Request a fresh narrow timeline
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a current-main implementation of a 24-hour timeline that preserves cron contracts and tracks broader calendar features separately.

options.title: Design the full calendar scope
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define the daily, weekly, stats, drag-and-drop, and validator behavior as one cohesive feature.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Leave the issue as product backlog and do not treat the stale linked branch as a landing path until a maintainer sponsors it.

recommendation.title: Request a fresh narrow timeline
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a current-main implementation of a 24-hour timeline that preserves cron contracts and tracks broader calendar features separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is primarily Control UI product-surface ownership, and Val Alexander has recent adjacent Control UI history around the old cron view and dashboard structure.
